description.value: The R.W. Starratt Wildlife Sanctuary protects Cranberry Marsh near Valemount in the Robson Valley, a wetland known for bird and wildlife viewing. The trailhead provides access to a nature trail through this BC Nature-recognized sanctuary. It sits in a scenic mountain corridor that touring cyclists passing through Valemount on Highway 5 may find worth a short detour.
